title: White Teeth
author: Zadie Smith
summary: In north London, Archie Jones and his Bangladeshi friend Samad Iqbal raise their families across several decades. The novel is a comic, crowded look at immigration, faith, science and belonging.
readIf: you enjoy big, funny, many-voiced novels about family and multicultural London.
skipIf: you prefer a single tight plot over a sprawling cast and digressions.
